proposed.sourceName: Darul Ifta Birmingham — 'Ruling of Carmine (E120) Cochineal Insects' (Maulana Mohammed Haroon Hussain)
proposed.paraphrase: This Hanafi fatwa rules carmine (E120) from cochineal insects impermissible to consume — insects are khabaith and only locusts/necessity/negligible-unavoidable amounts are excepted; deliberately added carmine does not qualify. The strict/cautious consumer therefore avoids it.

proposed.sourceName: Darul-Ifta, al-Jamia al-Ulum al-Islamiyya (Binnori Town) — 'Ruling on Carmine in Food' via SeekersGuidance (Mawlana Ilyas Patel)
proposed.paraphrase: Per the majority of jurists, consuming carmine (cochineal insect dye) is impermissible because insects are khabaith (Qur'an 7:157) — supporting strict avoidance of E120 in food.

researcherNote: E120 seeded zabiha = grade 4 (Questionable — widely avoided). The strict/cautious (zabiha-conscious) position follows the majority prohibition on insect consumption, so it avoids carmine. Two independent tier-1 fatwas ruling impermissible. APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01.
